title: Tropo One-Prompt Release Scorecard v1/v2
description: Closed schema (draft 2020-12) for the rehearsal and real-fire scorecards written by dev-spec 2fae6312 step 8. Every object is closed (additionalProperties:false) and every metric is required, because the spec's rule is that missing or invalid metrics make the acceptance criterion NON-PASSING. A scorecard that can omit a field is a scorecard that can report a release it did not measure.

schema_version.description: v2 (3d8d4351): mode-dependent verdict domain, actor-aware gestures, checkpoints_performed on rehearsal, derivation block on real-fire. v1 cards stay readable forever; validators branch on this field.

mode.description: Rehearsal and real-fire scorecards live at separate fixed paths and are never merged; a rehearsal that could be read as a real fire is a false public record.

saga_id.description: accepts-both uid shape. The 8-only pattern this replaced could not validate any release opened after the composite mint flip of 2026-08-31 -- run f015af4a6a0a is 12 hex -- so the scorecard was unvalidatable for this release and every future one, and the fire preflight refused on it. LOWERCASE-EXACT ON PURPOSE: a scorecard field is ADMISSION (is this value a governed uid), not extraction, and governed_path is explicit that the case-insensitive UID_HEX_PATTERN is only for finding uid-shaped text inside a larger document. ONE HOME for the shape fact: vault/tools/lib/governed_path.py UID_SHAPES. JSON Schema cannot import it, so this literal is derived from it by test_scorecard_uid_shape_accepts_both.py, which fails when the two disagree.

pipeline_run_uid.description: accepts-both uid shape; same one home and same derivation test as saga_id above (vault/tools/lib/governed_path.py UID_SHAPES).

gestures.description: The three-gesture target. Machine continuation is not a gesture; every manual resume or re-invocation is another principal input and fails the target.

items.description: v1 rows carry the principal-input name; v2 rows carry the journal event class (3d8d4351).

target.description: 3 = the classic rehearsal target; 2 = REAL_FIRE's ratchet (the lock and the go/no-go — 3d8d4351 §4).

timestamps.description: Four distinct moments. primary_live_at and all_targets_live_at differ whenever the site lags the primary publication, which is exactly the partial state the saga refuses to paper over.

elapsed.description: v1 measures lock->all-targets-live; v2 measures lock->primary-live (all-targets is the completion verifier's fact). Exactly one anchor is expected per version; the validator's v2 branch asserts it.

lock_to_primary_live_seconds.description: v2: lock to primary live; all-targets is the completion verifier's fact, not the predicate's.

refusals.description: Occurrences and distinct classes are counted separately: five refusals of one class and five of five are different releases. An ID absent from the baseline is new by definition and is never folded in silently.

occurrences.description: null when refusals were not recorded.

distinct_classes.description: null when refusals were not recorded.

unknown.description: New refusal classes. A non-empty list is a finding, not a failure of this schema.

recorded.description: Whether refusals were MEASURED for this run. false means not recorded, which is a different fact from zero observed; the schema previously could not express the difference, so every scorecard it accepted asserted a measurement it may not have taken. Stream 1 AC4, 2026-08-24.

coverage.description: The surfaces the refusal count actually observed. Refusal telemetry is emitted by five tools, not by every refusing surface; a count that does not say what it covered invites being read as a total.

verdict.description: v1/v2 rehearsal: pass|fail. v2 real-fire: the journal-derived triple.

checkpoints_performed.description: v2 rehearsal: the checkpoint count actually exercised (§7's gate reads it).

verdict_derivation.description: v2 real-fire: which rows produced the verdict — a verdict a human cannot audit is the opacity this schema exists to remove.

principal_gesture_rows.description: v2 real-fire: the span_ids of the counted principal gestures.
